此操作无法撤销。请输入“重新开始”；如需彻底删除旧数据，请同时勾选删除应用管理的: This cannot be undone. Enter “START OVER”. To remove all old data, also select deletion of app-managed backups.

勾选后将无法再用这些备份恢复旧账本: Once selected, these backups can no longer restore the old ledger.

SalaryFlow 0.5.0 · 本地个人预算与现金流: SalaryFlow 0.5.0 · Local budgeting and cash flow
适合理财账户：市值涨跌通过估值更新，不计为收入或支出；不能设为工资或消费账户。: For investment accounts: update market value through valuations without counting changes as income or expense. Cannot be a salary or spending account.
填写当日收盘后或当前看到的总市值。同一天再次保存会更新当天估值；市场涨跌不计收入: Enter the total market value shown now or after market close. Saving again on the same date updates that valuation; market changes are not income or expense.
工资到账后，补足生活资金，再安排储蓄与理财。: After salary arrives, fund daily spending first, then savings and investments.
预算余额是计划额度；消费账户余额是实际资金。: Budget remaining is the plan; the spending account balance is actual cash.
取本周期剩余预算与主要消费账户可用余额中较小的非负值: The smaller non-negative value of remaining budget and the primary spending account balance
切换全部账户总资产金额: Toggle total assets on Accounts page
仅控制“我的账户”页总资产；全局金额显示关闭时仍会隐藏: Controls total assets only on the Accounts page; the global switch still overrides it
尚未录入估值，当前按流水余额显示: No valuation yet; showing transaction balance
预算按所选周期管理；统计分析始终按交易实际发生日期筛选。: Budgets follow the selected period; analytics always filter by actual transaction date.
每月1日起算: Starts on the first day of each month
可立即应用、从下一个周期开始，或指定未来日期。若边界内已有交易，应用会阻止不安全: Apply now, from the next period, or on a specified future date. Existing transactions prevent unsafe boundary changes.
工资到账日作为每个预算周期的起点。: Each budget period starts on salary day.
每个预算周期固定为自然月1日至月底。: Each budget period runs from the first to the last day of the calendar month.
依据本周期剩余预算和主要消费账户余额，先计算需要补入的生活资金，再把可分配余款安: Use the remaining budget and primary spending balance to fund daily spending first, then direct the remainder to savings or investments.
薪流不会连接银行或执行真实转账。你在银行完成转账后，可逐项记录，或点击“我已完成: SalaryFlow does not connect to banks or move money. After completing bank transfers, record them individually or all at once.
选择本周期工资收入: Choose salary income for this period
本周期还没有工资收入: No salary income in this period
记录收入时勾选“工资收入”，即可在这里生成分配方案。: Mark an income as salary to create an allocation plan here.
计划与实际内部转账分开保存，避免重复记账。: Plans and actual internal transfers are stored separately to prevent duplicate accounting.
先从上方选择一笔工资收入。: Choose a salary income above first.
仅在你已经通过银行完成下列全部转账后确认。薪流会一次性创建对应内部转账记录。: Confirm only after completing every listed bank transfer. SalaryFlow will create the matching internal transfers together.
我已完成银行转账，记录全部: I completed the bank transfers; record all
请以银行实际转账为准；若已手动记账，可关联已有转账ID。: Use the actual bank transfer as the source of truth; link an existing transfer ID if already recorded.
计划将从列表隐藏；已经记录的真实转账仍保留在交易记录中。: The plan will be hidden; recorded transfers remain in transaction history.
先补消费账户，余款再安排储蓄: Top up spending first, then allocate the remainder
“本周期工资总额”会汇总本周期所有标记为工资的有效收入，并随各周期实际工资变化；: Salary total sums all valid salary income in this period and changes with each period. Source balance suits a salary account normally emptied after allocation. Custom uses your amount.
本周期剩余预算是计划；消费账户余额是真实资金。建议补足额＝剩余预算－消费账户余额: Remaining budget is the plan while the spending balance is actual cash. Suggested top-up equals remaining budget minus spending balance, floored at zero.
留空时，补足消费账户后的余款继续留在工资账户。: If blank, the remainder stays in the salary account after the spending top-up.
工资账户保留金额（元）: Amount to keep in salary account (CNY)
分配完成后希望仍留在工资账户的最低金额。: Minimum amount to keep in the salary account after allocation.
未选择账户，余款留在工资账户: No account selected; remainder stays in salary account
上限或源账户余额不足时才会出现: Shown when the limit or source balance is insufficient
保存只生成计划，不会操作银行。实际完成转账后，到“工资分配”页逐项记录或一次记录: Saving creates a plan and does not move bank funds. After the transfers, record them individually or together on the Allocation page.
填写当日收盘后或当前看到的总市值。估值会包含保存前已记录的当日流水；之后新记的同: Enter the current or closing market value. It includes same-day transactions recorded before the valuation; same-day transfers recorded later are added. Saving again on the same date updates the valuation.
已经是第一页，没有上一页。: You are already on the first page.
已经是最后一页，没有下一页。: You are already on the last page.
本周期已经结算。请先重新打开周期，再调整本周期预算。: This period is settled. Reopen it before adjusting its budget.
修改当前周期的分类预算；可选择同时更新个人默认预算。: Change category budgets for this period, with an option to update personal defaults too.
这个账户已经排在最前面，不能继续上移。: This account is already first and cannot move further up.
将这个账户向前移动一位。: Move this account one position up.
录入某日账户总市值。市值涨跌只改变资产余额，不计为收入或支出。: Enter the account's total market value on a date. Market changes affect assets without counting as income or expenses.
将账面余额调整为实际余额；产生的差额属于校准，不计收入、支出或预算。: Set the ledger balance to the actual balance. The adjustment does not count as income, expenses, or budget use.
把账户记账起点向更早日期扩展，需要填写新起点当时的真实余额。: Extend the account start to an earlier date by entering its actual balance at that new starting point.
恢复后账户会重新出现在日常选择中，历史记录始终保留。: Restoring makes the account available for new entries again. Its history is always retained.
归档后账户不再用于新交易，但余额和历史记录仍保留在总资产中。: Archiving removes the account from new entries while retaining its balance and history in total assets.
该分类已归档。请先点击“恢复”，再修改名称或分组。: This category is archived. Restore it before changing its name or group.
修改分类名称或分组；历史交易仍保留当时的分类版本。: Change the category name or group; historical transactions retain the version used at the time.
请先在左侧选择一个尚未加入预算的支出分类。: First choose an expense category that is not yet in the budget.
现有可用支出分类已全部加入预算。要创建新分类，请前往“设置与数据 → 收支分类: All available expense categories are already in this budget. To create one, go to Settings & Data > Income & Expense Categories > Add Category.
只在银行转账已经全部完成后使用；这里会批量记录内部转账，不会向银行发起转账。: Use only after all bank transfers are complete. This records internal transfers together and never initiates bank transfers.
银行转账已完成但尚未记账时选择记录；如果已经记过转账，则填写交易ID进行关联。: Choose Record after the bank transfer if it is not in the ledger. If already recorded, link it by transaction ID.
取消所有尚未完成的计划项；已经记录的真实转账不会撤销。: Cancel all unfinished plan items. Recorded transfers are not reversed.
只把已取消计划从列表中隐藏；已经记录的转账仍保留在交易记录中。: Hide only the cancelled plan from this list. Recorded transfers remain in transaction history.
只保存这份分配建议，不会发起银行转账，也不会立即生成交易记录。: Save only this allocation proposal. It does not initiate bank transfers or immediately create transaction records.
该行存在错误，不能导入。请根据右侧原因修正源文件后重新选择。: This row has an error and cannot be imported. Fix the source file using the reason shown on the right, then select it again.
勾选决定这一行是否随本批次导入。: Select whether this row is included in the import batch.
可输入金额或使用 + - * / ( ) 计算，结果四舍五入到分: Enter an amount or calculate with + - * / ( ). The final result is rounded to cents.
金额算式过长: The amount expression is too long.
金额算式只能包含数字和 + - * / ( ): Amount expressions can contain only numbers and + - * / ( ).
